messages:
maya (Product): quick heads-up — we need to finalize acceptance criteria and edge-case handling for the Optimize toolkit RFC today. customers asked for clear guidance on batching + caching + quantization. who can take point on PRD language and launch checklist?
raj (Eng-ML): i can draft acceptance criteria. proposing we split into: 1) recommendations-only MVP (no auto-tuning), 2) ops primitives for caching + batching, 3) quant profiles w/ quality guardrails.
courtney (Eng-Platform): +1 on recommendations-only MVP. need to be explicit about what console hooks are required for rollout (metric surfaces, toggles).
liam (Eng-Runtime): we should list edge cases up front: multi-tenant KV cache collisions, prefix caching invalidation, streaming + batch interaction, and quantization-induced hallucination risk for small-context tasks.
eva (SRE): also add failure-mode SLOs: if cache backend returns 5xx or stalls >200ms we should fallback to uncached path and emit a metric. rollout policy must include circuit-breaker for degraded accuracy.
raj (Eng-ML): draft acceptance criteria suggestion: - latency: median inference improvement >=10% for benchmark QPS with batching enabled - cost: token CPU/GPU cost reduction >=15% for typical workloads - quality: automated eval on reference prompts shows no >=2% drop in task accuracy/ROUGE/BLEU depending on workload - compatibility: supports seq2seq and decoder-only models in catalog - safety: quantized models pass existing safety filters
maya (Product): those look good. add launch gating: docs + example configs, console dashboard for per-route token cost, one customer beta, and runbooks for rollback.
liam (Eng-Runtime): example config snippet for caching + quantization we'd include in PRD:
```
optimize_settings:
  batching:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_size: 64
    max_wait_ms: 10
  caching:
    strategy: prefix-kv
    ttl_ms: 30000
    namespace: route-id
  quantization_profile: q4_0
  safety_watchlist: true
```
raj (Eng-ML): edge cases list (short bullets): - multi-turn chat where KV cache must be invalidated after system prompt change - length extrapolation: quant profiles degrade after sequences >2048 tokens - heterogeneous hardware: fallback to float32 if quant kernel missing - rescore/rerank pipelines where cached prefix misleads scoring
courtney (Eng-Platform): can we keep the initial rollout to hosted + dedicated only? private deploys often have custom KMS and on-prem libs that complicate quant kernels. prefer to scope MVP to hosted/dedicated.
maya (Product): yes, limit MVP to hosted + dedicated. mark private as "post-MVP".
eva (SRE): acceptance criteria should include observability: p50/p95/p99 token latency, cache hit ratio, tokens-per-second, and a data-drift signal for quality regressions. also add alert thresholds.
raj (Eng-ML): quality gating idea: run eval harness on a small prompt set each deploy. if metric delta > threshold (e.g., accuracy drop >1.5%) then block rollout. that's automated, but keeps recommendations non-automated.
liam (Eng-Runtime): implementation constraint: runtime must support per-route cache namespaces + an API to evict namespace keys. add API contract to PRD.
maya (Product): scope negotiation: product wants quick win for customers asking for explicit guidance and default safe profiles. engineering: wants to avoid ship-and-forget auto-tuning. compromise: ship opinionated defaults + conservative quant profiles and an opt-in 'aggressive' profile for beta users.
courtney (Eng-Platform): rollout plan: 1) internal alpha (canaries on infra team) 2) invite-only beta with 2-3 customers (low QPS) 3) gradual ramp with metric-based gates 4) GA. add runbook and rollback steps per route.
raj (Eng-ML): i will prepare PRD section: acceptance criteria, edge cases, sample configs, eval harness + gating. target PRD draft by EOD. assign to review: courtney + liam + maya.
maya (Product): sounds good. can someone add the console dashboard requirements (per-route cost, cache hit ratio, quality regression graph)? courtney?
courtney (Eng-Platform): i'll scope dashboard tiles: per-route p50/p95 latency, cache hit ratio, cost per 1M tokens, quality regressions overlayed. will draft wire text.
infra-bot: RFC created: /rfc/optimize-toolkit-2026 (doc link) :white_check_mark:
maya (Product): ok action items: raj (PRD draft), courtney (console wire + rollout checklist), liam (runtime API + evict contract), eva (SLOs + runbook). will sync 2pm PT. :calendar:
liam (Eng-Runtime): noted. quick question — for quantization profiles should we expose profile names only (q2, q4, q8) or a knob for per-layer opt-out? per-layer opt-out complicates UI.
raj (Eng-ML): recommend profile names only for MVP. track per-layer opt-out as a post-MVP engineer-only advanced setting.
maya (Product): agreed. keep MVP simple. thanks all — see you at 2pm sync. :thumbsup:
